title: The Onion Services Ecosystem
description: A searchable collection of onion-service technology, applications, documentation and research from the Tor community.
caution: A catalogue is not a guarantee that every listed service is online or trustworthy.

title: Tor Project Onion-Service Index
description: The Tor Project's own published list of its onion services, useful for checking operator-published addresses.
caution: Always compare an address with the operator's own current page before relying on it.

title: What is an onion service?
description: Official explanation of onion addresses, their privacy properties, and how Tor Browser identifies an onion connection.
caution: Onion routing does not protect against every form of identification or a compromised device.

title: Troubleshooting onion services
description: Official troubleshooting guidance for incorrect addresses, unavailable services and connection errors.

title: Tor Project Blog
description: The Tor Project's public blog, available through its operator-listed onion service.
caution: Copy this address into Tor Browser. This prototype cannot establish a Tor connection.

title: Tor Community
description: Community documentation and guidance published by the Tor Project, with an official onion address.
caution: Copy this address into Tor Browser. This prototype cannot establish a Tor connection.

title: Tor Project Forum
description: The Tor community forum, listed among the Tor Project's own onion services.
caution: A valid address does not mean a page or forum post is safe to trust.

title: Tor Project GitLab
description: The Tor Project's code collaboration service, reachable through its published onion-service address.
caution: Do not enter credentials unless you have independently verified the destination.

title: Tor Metrics
description: Public statistics and research about the Tor network through an address listed by the Tor Project.
caution: Copy this address into Tor Browser. This prototype cannot establish a Tor connection.

title: SecureDrop Documentation
description: Official documentation for SecureDrop, an open-source system used by news organizations to accept information from sources.
caution: For any real submission, follow the receiving newsroom's own official instructions and verify its address independently.

title: SecureDrop Organization Directory
description: Public directory of news organizations that operate SecureDrop instances, maintained by the Freedom of the Press Foundation.
caution: A directory listing alone is not enough to verify a submission address. Compare it with the newsroom's own official landing page.

title: SecureDrop Source Safety Guide
description: Guidance for sources on understanding the submission process and reducing mistakes that could identify them.
caution: Submitting sensitive information can have serious consequences; follow the organization's current instructions and seek trusted advice.

title: OnionShare
description: Open-source tool documentation for sharing files and hosting services over the Tor network.
caution: Review the project's current security guidance before using any file-sharing tool for sensitive material.

title: Tails
description: Official documentation for the portable operating system designed to help people use a computer more privately.
caution: No operating system can protect against every physical, account, or device-level risk.

title: Surveillance Self-Defense
description: Plain-language security guides from the Electronic Frontier Foundation for understanding digital risks and protective choices.

title: Access Now Digital Security Helpline
description: A digital-security support service for people and organizations facing urgent digital threats, with eligibility and availability set by the provider.
caution: Review current eligibility, communication options and safety notes on the provider's official page.

title: Freedom of the Press Foundation
description: A nonprofit that supports press freedom, secure journalism tools and safer communication between sources and newsrooms.
